sink.preCopyScript: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[StudentPerformance_Exp09]') AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[StudentPerformance_Exp09] ([StudentID] INT, [Name] NVARCHAR(100), [Age] INT, [Gender] NVARCHAR(20), [MathScore] INT, [ReadingScore] INT, [WritingScore] INT, [AttendanceRate] FLOAT, [StudyHoursPerWeek] FLOAT, [ParentEducation] NVARCHAR(50), [LunchType] NVARCHAR(50), [TestPrepCourse] NVARCHAR(50), [FinalGrade] NVARCHAR(10)) END
